doc_friction.issue: Step 1 says run `sample`, but `sample` itself prints that today's mode is census; the prompt never mentions modes, so a reader of only the track prompt would run the wrong mode. The README's 'Five modes' section is the real procedure.
`mode` printed weights summing to 1.25 (fix 0.5 doubled) without saying they are renormalised; harmless but confusing.

notes: Mode census (seeded draw). Seed 2026-11-17-7681. Subjects: research/simdesign-gaugescatter, ventures/patio-door-bid-calculator, research/decentralized-verification-markets, ventures/fdr-multiple-testing, research/osrobot-dofbom, ventures/earthwork-cut-fill. Share meeting the bar: 1 of 6 (fdr-multiple-testing); 5 of 6 finished. Seeded mutants caught 21 of 38; correctness recomputations passed 32 of 45. One auditor agent per subject in parallel; I reran each headline recomputation (dofbom 66.38/121.94/1.837/57.9; fdr BH 0.035625; patio 6432.51; earthwork 9.375/3.8194 yd3; gaugescatter 99.97/131.14 MPa; dvm CA+penalty honest gap +153.36, plain b=2 Brier 0.0112) and all matched. Fix PRs: #17050 (this PR): fdr null->p=0, earthwork comma split + privacy claim, patio restore freezing kit prices + walk-away mislabel, dofbom test pins + target guard, gaugescatter mesh-artefact pointer + beam-bounded tip test (kills plane-strain and 0.8-load mutants), dvm four README claim corrections. Portfolio-wide patterns found, not fixed: the restore-marks-all-edited applyValues block in 38 venture index.html files, and 'Nothing is sent anywhere' on 163 venture pages despite the deployed page-view counter. Open: DVM CA needs the published penalty term implemented and follow-ups rerun. Local checks: run_venture_tests for the three ventures (all ok), research homepage build ok, check_md_links ok, research_live_links ok, quality_audit validate 454 files 0 problems, post front matter/links/similarity ok; run_workflow_locally --for-changes result below.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: six independent expert audits with recomputation and mutation testing (~2 h each) plus six fixes with tests and a post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
